entries.title: Jeremiah 20:1
segments: When Pashur the son of Immer the priest (he was chief officer in the house of the LORD) heard Jeremiah prophesying these things,

entries.title: Jeremiah 20:2
segments: then Pashur struck Jeremiah the prophet, and put him in the stocks that [were] in the upper Benjamin Gate, which [was] by the house of the LORD.

entries.title: Jeremiah 20:3
segments: And it happened on the next day, Pashur brought Jeremiah out of the stocks. Then Jeremiah said to him, The LORD has not called your name Pashur, but Terror from All Around.

entries.title: Jeremiah 20:4
segments: For so says the LORD, Behold, I will make you a terror to yourself and to all your friends. And they shall fall by the sword of their enemies, and your eyes shall behold [it]. And I will give all Judah into the king of Babylon's hand, and he will exile them into Babylon, and kill them with the sword.

entries.title: Jeremiah 20:5
segments: And I will give all the wealth of this city, and its produce, and all its precious things, and all the treasures of the kings of Judah, [even] I will give into the hand of their enemies; who will strip them and take them, and bring them to Babylon.

entries.title: Jeremiah 20:6
segments: And you, Pashur, and all who dwell in your house, shall go into captivity. And you shall come to Babylon, and you shall die there, and shall be buried there; you and all your friends to whom you have prophesied lies.

entries.title: Jeremiah 20:7
segments: O LORD, You have deceived me, and I was deceived. You are stronger than I, and You have prevailed. I am in derision all the day; everyone laughs at me.

entries.title: Jeremiah 20:8
segments: For whenever I speak, I cry out, I cry violence and ruin; for the word of the LORD has been a reproach and a cause of mocking to me all day.

entries.title: Jeremiah 20:9
segments: Then I said, I will not mention Him, nor speak in His name any more. But [His word] was in my heart like a burning fire shut up in my bones, and I was weary with holding in, and I could not stop.

entries.title: Jeremiah 20:10
segments: For I heard the slanders of many, Terror is all around! Expose! Yea, let us expose him! Every man of my peace is watching for my fall, [saying], Perhaps he will be lured away, and we shall prevail over him, and we shall take our revenge on him.

entries.title: Jeremiah 20:11
segments: But the LORD [is] with me like a mighty, awesome one. Therefore my persecutors shall stumble, and they shall not overcome me. They shall be greatly ashamed; for they shall not be blessed. [Their] everlasting shame shall never be forgotten.

entries.title: Jeremiah 20:12
segments: But, O LORD of hosts, who tries the righteous [and] sees the reins and the heart, let me see Your vengeance on them. For I have committed my cause to You.

entries.title: Jeremiah 20:13
segments: Sing to the LORD, praise the LORD; for He has delivered the soul of the poor from the hand of evildoers.

entries.title: Jeremiah 20:14
segments: Cursed [is] the day in which I was born; let not the day in which my mother bore me be blessed.

entries.title: Jeremiah 20:15
segments: Cursed [is] the man who brought news to my father, saying, A man child is born to you; making him very glad.

entries.title: Jeremiah 20:16
segments: And let that man be as the cities which the LORD overthrew, and repented not; and let him hear the cry in the morning, and the shouting at noontide;

entries.title: Jeremiah 20:17
segments: because he did not kill me from the womb; or that my mother might have been my grave, and her womb [to be] always great [with me].

entries.title: Jeremiah 20:18
segments: Why did I come forth from the womb to see labor and sorrow, that my days should be consumed in shame?
